market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $115 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$100 currently; $115 requires +15% rally in remaining ~25 days. With Iran ceasefire holding and sanctions partially eased, supply outlook is bearish. Such a rally in a single month is rare (~10-15% probability) absent a major escalation.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran ceasefire breaking down rapidly is the main upside risk.
